task_instance: Run `aspire init --language typescript --non-interactive` inside a small existing Node.js repo (sample-repo/ with package.json and api/index.js) to add an Aspire AppHost skeleton, per Workflow B of the skill.
blocker_detail: The Aspire CLI (installed successfully via `npm install -g @microsoft/aspire-cli`, version 13.5.4) requires network access to NuGet's search API (azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org / azuresearch-ussc.nuget.org) and related Azure endpoints (pkgs.dev.azure.com, Azure Application Insights) to restore packages and build its 'prebuilt AppHost server' before it can run `aspire init`. The sandbox's outbound proxy explicitly denies CONNECT to these hosts with HTTP 403 ('gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)'), confirmed both by direct curl (CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403) and by the proxy's own /__agentproxy/status recentRelayFailures log. As a result `aspire init` always fails with 'Failed to prepare: A task was canceled.' / 'Failed to build AppHost server.' / 'The app could not be created.' (exit code 4), even with --non-interactive and an explicit --language. Additionally, the .NET 10 SDK prerequisite listed in the skill is not installed in this runtime (only Node.js 22 and the npm-distributed aspire-cli are available), which would be a secondary blocker for the C#-based AppHost path even if network access were available.
evidence: Commands: `npm install -g @microsoft/aspire-cli` (succeeded, aspire --version -> 13.5.4+9c1b401dd67746739044f68959cbf4d3d7af93a6). `aspire doctor` crashed with an unrelated Spectre.Console rendering exception in this non-interactive terminal. Created sample-repo/{package.json, api/index.js}. Ran `COLUMNS=80 LINES=24 TERM=xterm timeout 20 aspire init --language typescript --non-interactive` inside sample-repo -> exit 124/4, stderr: '⚙️ Preparing Aspire server... 🛑 Stopping Aspire. ❌ Failed to prepare: A task was canceled. ❌ Failed to build AppHost server. ❌ The app could not be created.' CLI debug log at /root/.aspire/logs/cli_20260926T172737_f47b1a82.log shows repeated 'Warning: Failed to search nuget.org: Failed to retrieve metadata from source https://azuresearch-ussc.nuget.org/query?...' during NuGet restore of Aspire.Cli / Aspire.ProjectTemplates packages, which never completes. Verified independently: `curl --max-time 15 https://azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org/query?q=Aspire.Cli&take=1` -> 'curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' (while https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json returns 200). `curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status` lists recentRelayFailures with repeated connect_rejected entries (403) for azuresearch-usnc.nuget.org, pkgs.dev.azure.com, and centralus-2.in.applicationinsights.azure.com — hosts the Aspire CLI needs but that are not in the proxy's allowed set. No AppHost skeleton (apphost.mts, aspire.config.json, .aspire/modules) was ever produced; the deliverable described in the skill (a dropped AppHost skeleton ready for aspireify handoff) could not be created in this runtime.
